verdict.rationale: Drata is a SaaS compliance platform that handles customer data and offers AI features such as AI-agent and MCP access, so asking whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses that: no training opt-out, AI data-use policy, or no-training commitment is documented. The MCP and AI-agent items describe integration capabilities, not data-use controls, and the community items concern the endpoint agent, not AI training.
